summary: This bill amends federal criminal law to require any health care practitioner present at the live birth resulting from an abortion or attempted abortion to provide the same degree of care needed to preserve the infant's life as would be given any other newborn at the same gestational age, immediately transport the infant to a hospital, and report violations, while imposing fines, up to 5 years in prison, or murder penalties for intentional killing and allowing civil suits by the mother.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes criminal penalties for healthcare practitioners who fail to provide care to a child born alive after an abortion or who fail to report such an incident. It also specifies that intentionally killing such a child can be prosecuted as murder, indicating a focus on stricter enforcement and penalties for specific actions.
